lines.trans: I have two pieces of news, and both are good.
After the assassination attempt, I survived.
Our restaurant has finally found a spiritual leader.
Please welcome and respect him.
German Mikhailovich.
The new head chef of our restaurant.
Thank you, Dmitry Vladimirovich.
I hope to live up to your high trust.
Let's come to an agreement right away.
You do not have to love me.
But making friends with me is certainly worth it.
Good day to everyone. Back to work.

meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'you (polite or plural)' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.en: to drive out, to force out (someone)

examples.text: В общем, если выживет, то хорошо.

examples.trans: If I survive, I'll stop stealing food!

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
+ infinitive: не даёт мне готовить
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.note: + genitive.

meanings.note: About people.
in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

meanings.en: to agree, to come to an arrangement
meanings.note: 'договоримся' = we'll work something out

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

examples.text: Наш ресторан обрёл наконец духовного лидера.
examples.trans: Our restaurant has finally found a spiritual leader.

examples.text: Для него музыка это духовная пища.
examples.trans: For him music is spiritual food.

meanings.note: mostly in the set phrase прошу любить и жаловать = please make (him/her) welcome

examples.text: Друзья, прошу всех любить и жаловать!
examples.trans: Friends, please give them all a warm welcome!

examples.text: В общем, прошу любить и жаловать.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Хорошая новость = good news.
Plural новости, also the TV news programme.

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.

examples.text: Вы сейчас отсюда оба уходите. И больше сюда не возвращаетесь. Ясно?

meanings.note: Bookish: обрести покой = find peace.

meanings.note: Firm promise or requirement.

examples.text: Государство обязательно увидит и назначит операцию.

meanings.note: of a court: меня оправдают = they'll acquit me
оправдать надежды = to live up to hopes

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда, меня оправдают. Аракелян заявление заберёт.
examples.trans: I'll get out of here, they'll acquit me. Arakelyan will withdraw his statement.

examples.text: Хочешь понравиться женщине? Подружись с её ребёнком.
examples.trans: Want a woman to like you? Make friends with her child.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness

examples.text: Когда вырасту, ты будешь просить у меня прощения!
